title: Reaching the Nations Through Prayer and Intercession
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he declares war on the spiritual principalities that have held back the spread of the Gospel in a specific region. With a renewed vision for global missions and a deep understanding of the power of intercession, Pastor Zehner shares a bold call to action for the church to rise up and reclaim the nations for Christ. Get ready to be inspired and motivated to join the mission to reach the world with the Good News of Jesus.
